intro.text: A fruit that grows in Azir, often made into jam.

description.text: Smoke from the plant's burning leaves and stalks is intoxicating and brings euphoria, while the berries themselves are safe to eat.

Legend has it that eating the berry or its jam makes a person speak only truth until the following sunset. Groups meet to burn the plant's leaves and stalks while eating the berries, which makes for lively nights.

items.text: On a picnic, Shallan and Kabsal ate truthberry jam. When he told her the legend behind the name, she said she was surprised they weren't called birthberries.
